name: Zoel AI
subtitle: Your private, on-device AI
shortDescription: A private AI that runs on your phone. Voice-first, multilingual, 15 domains. Health is free forever with no ads; other ads can be removed with one purchase.
longDescription:
Zoel AI is a private, on-device AI assistant. It runs entirely on your phone — your conversations, questions, and data never leave your device. No account. No cloud. Your conversations stay on your device.

### What Makes Zoel Ai Different
• 100% on-device — a small language model runs locally, so it works on a plane, in a tunnel, or anywhere with no signal.
• Total privacy — nothing is uploaded. A clear "on-device · private" banner always tells you where each answer comes from.
• Voice-first and multilingual — talk or type, and Zoel replies in your language.
• A built-in, cited knowledge base across 15 life domains.

15 KNOWLEDGE DOMAINS
Health, Safety, Learning, Finance, Work, Relationships, Family, Legal, Home Life, Travel, Productivity, Civic, Spiritual, Legacy, and Companion.

HEALTH — FREE FOREVER
The full Health module is free for everyone: clear, sourced guidance on hundreds of conditions and topics — symptoms, medications, mental health, first aid, chronic care, women's and men's health, and more — with read-aloud and references from CDC, NIH, WHO, Mayo Clinic and other authoritative sources.

### Bring Your Own Model or Key
Prefer a larger on-device model, or your own cloud provider? Add it and Zoel uses it — you stay in control, and the privacy banner keeps you informed.

### Accessibility
Read-aloud on every knowledge page. Voice input and spoken answers.

### Membership
• Zoel Free — the Health module, plus AI conversation in every module.
• Zoel Select ($4.99 one-time) — Health plus any 4 modules you choose, forever.
• Zoel Unlimited ($4.99/month or $49.99/year) — every module, current and future.
• Remove Ads ($1.99 one-time) — removes all ads in the app.

Zoel AI — your private AI, running entirely on your device.

### Disclaimer
Zoel AI provides general information for educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical, legal, financial, or other advice, and it is not a medical device. AI-generated answers may be incomplete or inaccurate. Always consult a qualified professional before making decisions, and never disregard or delay seeking professional advice because of something you read in the app. In a medical emergency, contact your local emergency services immediately.
whatsNew: Adds ads in some modules (Google AdMob; never in Health, My Health or AI chat) and an optional one-time Remove Ads purchase.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
